Container.Name: Spokarr
Container.Overview:
Request audiobooks like you request movies in Seerr. Pick the exact edition from the Audible catalog (narrator, unabridged, language); Spokarr finds a matching release through Prowlarr or Newznab indexers, downloads it with SABnzbd, NZBGet or qBittorrent and imports it into Audiobookshelf – matched, with chapters and a "Requested by" tag. Users sign in with their Audiobookshelf accounts.
Setup: open the WebUI, enter your Audiobookshelf address and sign in with an Audiobookshelf admin account. Then add download clients and indexers under Settings. The Media path must be the share your download client writes to and Audiobookshelf reads from, so imports are a move or hardlink instead of a copy.
Container.Requires: Audiobookshelf 2.26 or newer, SABnzbd or NZBGet and/or qBittorrent or Transmission, Prowlarr or a Newznab indexer.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Share with your downloads and your audiobook library (same share for moves and hardlinks)

Config.Name: Library folder
Config.Description: Where Spokarr puts finished audiobooks, as seen inside the container (below /media). Must be the folder of your Audiobookshelf library.
